story.title: Mina spins a nap

pages.text: Mina is at a pit. Mina spins a nap.
pages.pictureTalk: Look, Mina is at the pit. Something fun is about to happen!
pages.illustrationHint: warm flat storybook scene: Mina the child standing at a pit, curious and smiling, soft colors

pages.text: a nap is in a pit. Mina spins a nap.
pages.pictureTalk: Do you see it? There is a nap. Mina sees it too.
pages.illustrationHint: warm flat storybook scene: Mina the child noticing a nap near a pit, eyes wide with delight

pages.text: a nap is tan. Mina spins a nap.
pages.pictureTalk: The nap is tan. Mina smiles and looks a little closer.
pages.illustrationHint: warm flat storybook scene: a close view of a tan nap while Mina the child smiles at it

pages.text: Mina is at a nap. Mina spins a nap.
pages.pictureTalk: Mina wants to be near the nap. It is just a little way off.
pages.illustrationHint: warm flat storybook scene: Mina the child looking toward a nap a little way off, hopeful and calm

story.offlineTask: Find something at home that reminds you of the story and tell your grown-up its name.
